styles.toon: Bold bright 2D cartoon illustration, thick clean dark outlines, flat candy colours with simple soft shading, big round googly eyes, rubbery squash-and-stretch shapes, goofy wacky expressions, cheerful kids TV animation look, no text.
styles.toon_item: Bold bright 2D cartoon illustration of a plain inanimate object, thick clean dark outlines, flat candy colours with simple soft shading, chunky rounded toy-like shapes, cheerful kids TV animation look, a simple prop with a smooth blank surface, no text.
styles.toon_place: Bold bright 2D cartoon background painting, thick clean dark outlines, flat candy colours with simple soft shading, wonky rubbery shapes, cheerful kids TV animation look, an empty deserted place, scenery only, no text.

negative: text, letters, words, numbers, watermark, logo, signature, blurry, low quality, extra limbs, deformed, photo, realistic, gore, blood, frightening horror, existing game characters, copyrighted characters, real people, ugly

pictures.name: hero-kitchen-knight-boy-1
